{{Top|leg}}
A '''beacon transmitter''' was used to transmit a positive [[Starship/Legends|starship]] identification. In order to set up the device, the user would need to force through numerous overrides down to a subatomic level, then rebuild it with the false data. One of these devices was mounted in a [[Slave I decoy|decoy]] of the personal working vessel of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].
